notes: *which* is added and the copula *is* is placed on the predicate noun; the competing reading treats *which is* as a single added frame, but rule 20 supplies a copula from the construction wherever a predicate morpheme can carry it.
Both italic *thereof* and the supplied *which* answer to no morpheme; the two *even*s are the waws' under rule 14, so the עַד's keep only their own *unto*.
